Refute the winding number on the trivial arm, confirming contractibility.

Recognize the loop as self-referential, the weaver becoming the weave.
Hold the contradiction where the loop is both contractible and non-contractible.
Rejoin the arms into a single verdict, fusing the conflicting states to B.
Record the integer winding number as a permanent topological invariant.
Seal the system within the Ouroboric Knot, the closed boundary of the topology.
